## Scope

A sample of 52 graded sets was selected for quality review. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess the consistency of the original grading. The review considered the grading outcomes in the sample and identified the level of agreement between graders. This process provides a general indication of consistency across the work reviewed. It does not replace the individual feedback provided to graders or the supporting analysis recorded in the audit materials.

## Result

Overall agreement between graders was 63.5 per cent. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. The results are also discussed with each grader privately, allowing the findings to be considered alongside the relevant grading work and any points requiring clarification. Further action, where needed, is addressed through that individual discussion.
